title: Filipino Beef Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew originating from the Philippines. This recipe is made with tender beef, plump tomatoes, and a hint of sweet plum sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onions and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and plum sauce to the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the stew mix and browned beef back to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
